_about: Frenzy fragment (List 30 #289) — Hyper Mode native as a #27 volatile condition gated on #287's closed heart, resolving on #182's machinery. Terrifying, never cool: the presentation law is part of the spec, not a note.

call.action: free action in #10's command ring — the keeper calls the individual by name (#239 record read)
call.cap: once per battle per individual (data may tune down)
call.on_failure: the call is spent; frenzy holds
call.on_success: frenzy clears AND #288's call-back gauge reduction applies

class: volatile (#27 family — battle-scoped, clears on switch/battle end, #182 rules verbatim)

effects.commands: may be refused / replaced by a #290 shadow move / spent idle — #273 disobedience family, frenzy weights
effects.shadow_moves: documented critical-lean while frenzied (value is data) — applies only to moves that leave at purification
effects.switch_by_order: refused (a switch is a command); switch by non-order effect clears frenzy with the class
effects.untouched: faint resolution (#182: nothing outranks a faint)

frequency_cap: at most one trigger per battle per individual (law; data may only lower)
gate: application requires heart.closed (#287) — an open-hearted individual fails application as if class-immune (#182 check step 2)
never_read_by: #270 reputation — a Mochi's frenzy is a symptom, never a deed
presentation: #147 dread beat: sound drops (#215), cry goes wrong (#155), keeper's call is the scene; a cut playing frenzy as power fantasy is a defect
trigger: per action attempt while closed; chance is condition data weighted by remaining gauge depth (deeper closure frenzies more — direction is law, shape is data)
